n01.comment: Mechanical, redundant symptom denials with synonym padding ("feels not exhausted, no low energy") and generic boilerplate read as templated generation.

n02.comment: Self-contradictory phrasing ("c/o denies", "denies photophobia, bothered by bright lights") and oddly precise labs with ratio units and "no flags listed" read as templated or generated rather than real charting.

n03.comment: Reads as generated: "fictional study condition" in the history, mechanical ROS phrasing ("negative for tired"), and uniformly formatted labs with odd precision and a redundant "ratio" unit.

n04.comment: Lab values have inconsistent, unnatural decimal precision (4.199, 30.93, 0.6902) with a repeated "(reference ...)" format on every line, and the ROS wording ("negative for shaky hands", "bothered by bright lights") reads as mechanically generated.

n05.comment: ROS uses mechanical "negative for X (denies X)" paraphrase pattern, and the lab list has uniform formatting with odd precision and "ratio" units, reading as generated rather than real charting.
